title: Claim Device
notes: Response includes effective_status (nullable string): one of ok, warning, error, offline, disconnected, never_seen. Computed device status reflecting incident priority, connectivity, telemetry-seen state, and raw device status.

title: Merge Device
notes: Merges one or more shadow devices under this primary device.
Merge group capped at 4 devices (1 primary + up to 3 shadows).

title: Split Device
notes: Detaches a shadow device from its primary.

title: Start Edge Claim
notes: Async endpoint: returns 204; poll organization.edge.getClaimStatus until pending/success/failed.
Legacy route live-verified on 2026-04-19: POST /core/v1/organization/edge/devices/start_claim returns 400 "Must provide proxy id" when called with an empty JSON body.
Server PR xyte-io/server#8732 made /core/v1/organization/edges/devices the canonical route; /core/v1/organization/edge/devices is legacy server compatibility and is not used by the CLI catalog.

title: Get Edge Models
notes: Server ticket BE-1580 adds this endpoint.
Search accepts either the `search` or `q` query param (the hub accepts both).
Returns paginated edge device models with { items, next_page }. Each item: { id, vendor, model, aliases: [string], parameters: [{ name, type, required }] }.
